title: Timbaland Debuts AI-Generated Tata Taktumi With 'Glitch x Pulse' (Rolling Stone)
notes: Rolling Stone (top-tier), Jon Blistein, 2025-10-10. TaTa debuts with 'Glitch x Pulse'; only lyrics fully human; AI voice + AI video (feat. Jabbawockeez); four human songwriters (Portillo, Aera, Haber, Avila); workflow = Timbaland demos -> Suno -> human lyrics.
